variants.headline: Looking back: party leader faces a challenge
variants.sub: A challenge to the leadership of {party} has opened.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The leader of {party} was being challenged.

An argument over leadership deserves workers' attention when it concerns whose needs a party represents. It deserves rather less admiration as a quarrel over a title. Labour should keep asking about work and daily life, rather than choosing a side on the strength of an internal contest alone.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The position of {target} deserves scrutiny without assuming that a challenge is either justified or doomed. The existence of a contest is the known fact on which this account rests.
